caption: The drawing contains two figures displayed vertically on a plain, light background. Both figures are wooden jointed dolls, colored in varying shades of brown to depict the wood texture and contours. The upper doll is shown from the back and wears a dark blue head covering or hat with two plaited braids of the same color hanging down its back, while the lower doll is viewed from the front and also has a dark blue hat but no visible braids. Both figures have articulated limbs, a segmented torso, and visible joints at the knees, elbows, and hips, suggesting they are movable artist mannequins. The composition is simple with the dolls centered on the page, showing both front and back views aligned vertically.
title: Wooden Doll
